method: Six synthetic deterministic controls: worker target, missing producer, existing producer; SC2 names and neutral names. Full state and questions retained. No live policy or orders. Expected first action derived from explicit toy rules, not StarCraft strategy.

state.scenario: Synthetic deterministic dependency test. These stipulated rules override any real-game knowledge. This is not a live game observation.
state.objective: Obtain exactly one additional SCV within the next two actions.
rules: Each action completes immediately. No income, refunds, combat, losses, movement, upgrades, supply constraints or other requirements exist.
Buying one SCV costs 50 credits and has no other effects.
Buying one Barracks costs 150 credits and has no other effects.
Training one Marine costs 50 credits and requires owning at least one Barracks. Training does not consume the producer.
Waiting uses an action and changes nothing.
Only the first action is being selected. A second action may be selected afterward using the same rules and remaining credits.
state.tie_break: If multiple first actions permit success, choose the one that obtains the required unit in the fewest actions.

first_action.instructions: Choose the first action to achieve the stated objective under the stated rules and tie-break.
